pre_schema_admission_ownership_rulings.ruling: The family defines an owner-namespaced stream and typed event projection. It mints no sequence, admission decision, receipt, state root, receipt root, or transition chain; append order, expected-head conflict handling, accepted roots, and receipts are referenced from the canonical Agentgres operation.

The family defines subscriber scope, filters, expiry/revocation, backpressure policy, and an acknowledged-checkpoint projection. It mints no admission or checkpoint receipt and owns no transition chain; every lease transition and checkpoint advance references the canonical Agentgres operation and receipt.

Typing and event classes: event kinds are typed by owner-declared payload schema refs scoped to the stream owner namespace; the family defines no closed global event-kind enum and admits no consumer vocabulary — including M5.0 GoalRun/thread-orchestration fields — as an admission-required field. Each owner namespace declares its admitted-truth classes versus ephemeral delivery-only classes; the numeric interactive latency budget for the ephemeral path is owned by the canon pass recorded in stages/m5.md canon gaps, not by this record.

contract_definition_of_done: Each family lands with a schema and invariants file, positive and negative fixtures, and a conformance owner that proves the named refusals.
Every cross-reference is declared authoritative or derived; no ambiguous bidirectional membership or lineage edge is accepted.

consequential_effects_and_final_invokers: effect: event append or subscription checkpoint advance | final_invoker: Agentgres operation admission | authority_source: daemon-resolved exact subscription lease and applicable grant | receipt_or_evidence: operation receipt, stream root, checkpoint receipt | negative_behavior: deny unleased delivery, stale checkpoint, silent lag loss, cross-owner subject, or adapter-local truth
positive_proof: One dynamically created leased subscription survives restart, resumes from its durable acknowledged checkpoint, and reconstructs exact accepted stream history.

A second, non-thread-orchestration owner namespace admits, replays, and serves a leased subscription through the identical canonical path; genericity is proven by the second customer, never assumed from the first.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Unleased delivery, cross-owner filters, expired/revoked leases, lag, checkpoint substitution, dropped adapter frames, restart, and rebase ambiguity fail closed or emit typed outcomes.

An ephemeral-class event presented for truth admission and an admitted-class event delivered without admission both fail closed with typed outcomes; any consumer-vocabulary field required at admission is a contract defect.
compatibility_and_migration: Existing broadcast, JSONL, fixed libp2p topics, and SSE bodies remain adapters or historical inputs and cannot satisfy the durable-subscription claim.
remaining_nonclaims: No general context-version, memory, sandbox, M4, or release claim.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop on any unleased delivery, non-atomic accepted append, silent accepted-event loss, or non-durable acknowledged checkpoint.

current_implementation_evidence: ADR 0030 TEST FINDING (measured 2026-08-01, branch agent/hypervisor-m4-end-state @219154326): the interim runtime thread-event plane this successor replaces is a parallel admission spine at the thread layer. crates/services/src/agentic/runtime/kernel/runtime_thread_event.rs mints its own per-stream admission sequence (seq = latest_seq + 1 read back from <state_dir>/events/<sha256(stream)>.jsonl), its own state-root chain (state_root_before/state_root_after), resulting heads, and admission decisions (status "admitted" plus admission_hash); its storage admission (AgentgresAdmissionCore.admit_storage_backend_write) validates shape and mints a local hash. Canonical Agentgres (crates/agentgres mux — the substrate M4 room transitions admit through in outcome_room_system_routes.rs) is never in the path; concurrency is the per-stream file lock event_log_bridge::with_event_stream_lock, not expected-head CAS (direct admission rejects caller-supplied expected_head/latest_seq/state_root_before, so no CAS refusal semantics exist); minted refs wear the fabricated namespace agentgres://runtime-events/... implying canonical admission that never happened. runtime_thread_fork_control.rs and runtime_managed_session_control.rs plan events admitted through that same path (daemon admit_and_persist_event) and mint receipt-ref identities (receipt_thread_fork_control_{fork_hash}, receipt_runtime_managed_session_projection_*) that no canonical receipt object backs — fabricated to satisfy the admission's MissingReceiptRefs floor. CONSEQUENCE: naive descriptive contracts for runtime-thread-event / thread-fork-control / managed-session-control would register this second spine's owned sequence/root/head/hash fields, which ADR 0030 forbids; the registered siblings (harness-session-binding-admission.v1, hypervisor-session-launch-recipe-admission.v1) show the allowed shape — agentgres_operation_refs/receipt_refs/state_root as references only, no owned chain. DISPOSITION: filed, not executed (post-ADR-0031 correction boundary). Contract paths: (a) after this successor re-homes accepted events onto atomic Agentgres head/root transitions, describe the re-homed admission; or (b) sibling-style request/decision reference contracts owning no sequence/root/chain field. The choice is an owner decision at M5.0 shaping.
